results.name: item_reset_change_color_function
results.evidence: Clears item flags bit 0x40 at datum+0x1f4 then, if the object type's function index at tag+0x31c is valid, calls FUN_00549af0(index,{0,1.0,1.0},-1,0,0,0,0) resembling a per-object shader/material function reset (e.g. team change-colors).
results.summary: Clears an item pending-change flag and resets an associated tag-defined material/shader function value for the object instance.

results.name: item_definition_reset_change_color_function
results.evidence: Same body as FUN_004bbb50 but reads the function index directly from the tag definition (in_EAX treated as a tag id, not an object id) and lacks the flag-clear step.
results.summary: Resets the same tag-defined material/shader function value as item_reset_change_color_function but operates on a tag/type reference rather than a live object instance.

results.name: item_build_orientation_update
results.evidence: Copies the item's resting up-vector and ground-normal (datum+0x1d..0x22, matching the same fields set in item_update/FUN_004bc5c0), a tag id, and a flag byte, then dispatches FUN_004ec940(0,0x1f,0,&locals,0,1,0) with fixed message id 0x1f; sibling FUN_004c0b10 uses id 0x1e with different fields.
results.prototype: void __cdecl item_build_orientation_update(unsigned int item_index, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
results.summary: Packages an item's resting orientation/ground-alignment vectors into a fixed-format record and hands it to the generic message dispatcher (FUN_004ec940) as message type 0x1f.

results.name: item_create_garbage
results.evidence: Behind an authority check (FUN_004ec590, else FUN_004ec670), computes a basis from two cross products, resolves two material ids from PTR_DAT_00687130/00687558 tables, then calls object_new_with_datum_role_control(...) and writes the new object's position/orientation fields (offsets 0x248-0x268).
results.summary: On the authoritative side, spawns a new locally-controlled (garbage-role) object at a computed basis derived from the current item, e.g. an ejected/detached piece, and initializes its transform fields.

results.name: item_build_network_update_dynamic
results.evidence: object_try_and_get(8) fetches the item, reads its flag/sequence byte pair at +0x245/+0x246, builds one of two field groups depending on param_4, and sends it via FUN_004ec940 using a message id looked up from a per-type vtable (&PTR_PTR_0069bfdc)[item->type]; increments the sequence byte at +0x246 with wraparound.
results.prototype: int __cdecl item_build_network_update_dynamic(int item_index, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, int update_type)
results.summary: Builds an outgoing per-type network update for an item's primary attachment/transform state, using a sequence counter for delta reliability.

results.name: item_update
results.evidence: cea-pdb hint 'item_update' via shared 'ground point' string; internally calls item_accelerate (FUN_004bd080) and item_align_to_normal_and_point (FUN_004bd5d0), queries the 'ground point' marker via FUN_004f6080, and drives the resting/airborne/bounce state machine (flags datum+4 bits 0x800/0x20/0x10/0x8/0x4).
results.summary: Per-tick physics update for a dropped/loose item: handles resting-on-ground alignment, bouncing off surfaces, gravity acceleration, and associated sound/particle triggers.

results.name: item_any_active_random_seed
results.evidence: Builds an object_iterator_next filter block (type=1) and scans all matching objects for one whose field at datum+0x1f8 (the per-item random 'seed'/spin value also touched by FUN_004bd450) is greater than zero.
results.summary: Iterates live item objects and returns true if any has a nonzero random seed/variation value set.

results.name: item_set_attachment_parent
results.evidence: Takes a new owner/parent object index in in_EDX; on -1 clears flag bits at datum+500, otherwise copies the owner's cached grip/forward field (owner+0x218) into the item and sets flags, calls FUN_004f7450(0), invalidates cached collision fields (+0x98,+0x9c,+0x9e), and marks the object dirty for bounding recompute.
results.summary: Sets or clears the item's attachment/owner reference and invalidates its cached grip/collision state accordingly.

results.name: item_accelerate
results.evidence: cea-pdb hint 'item_accelerate' via shared 'ground point' string; takes a delta vector (param_1) and integrates it into the item's position fields (datum+0x1a..0x1c) while updating angular velocity/torque, gated by the resting flag bit 0x20 at datum+0x7d.
results.summary: Applies a translational impulse/delta to an item, updating its position and inducing a corresponding spin/torque response.

results.name: item_ensure_random_seed
results.evidence: If the item's per-instance seed field at datum+0x1f8 is zero, calls FUN_004507a0 then generates one via FUN_006391b4 seeded from the global PRNG state DAT_00719cd0 and stores it.
results.summary: Lazily initializes an item's random seed/variation value the first time it is needed.

results.name: item_compute_ground_alignment_rotation
results.evidence: Normalizes the vector at datum+0x8c..0x94 (the ground-alignment axis set elsewhere as datum+0x86..0x88), stores sin/cos of its magnitude at datum+0x89/0x8a, and toggles flag bit 2 at datum+500; the sin/cos pair is consumed by vector3d_rotate_about_axis calls in item_update.
results.summary: Recomputes the normalized ground-alignment axis and its rotation angle (as sin/cos) used to smoothly rotate a resting item to match the surface normal.

results.name: item_align_to_normal_and_point
results.evidence: cea-pdb hint 'item_align_to_normal_and_point' via shared 'ground point' string; builds a rotation quaternion from a half-vector between the item's current basis and a target normal (param_1) via cross products and quaternion_rotate_vector, then outputs the item's rest-position basis (datum+0x5c/0x60/0x64).
results.summary: Computes a quaternion that rotates the item's current orientation to align with a given ground normal and reference point.

results.name: item_get_effective_position
results.evidence: object_try_and_get(0x1c) fetches the item; if not marked 'attached' (flag bit0 of +500 clear) it copies the item's own cached position fields (+0xa0..0xa8) to the caller's output, otherwise follows the attachment index at +0xc0 through datum_get to the parent object and repeats.
results.summary: Returns an item's world position, following the attachment chain to a parent object when the item itself has no direct position.

results.name: item_drop
results.evidence: Copies the item's live position (datum+0x5c/0x60/0x64, the standard object-header position offset) plus a hash_table_get-derived id into a record sent via FUN_004ec940 as message 0x30, then broadcasts via FUN_004e1a80(1,&DAT_00871de0,...) and sets datum+4 (the object's role/type word) to 3.
results.summary: Marks an item as no longer held, broadcasts its current position/state to observers, and posts an associated notification.

results.name: item_destroy
results.evidence: Behind the same *(int*)*in_EAX==0 authority gate as item_create_garbage, resolves a material id, sets the object's role/type word (datum+4) to 3, calls item_detonate (FUN_004c0670), item_update_max_permutation_reached (FUN_004bf0f0), and two unnamed cleanup helpers.
results.summary: Authoritatively transitions an item out of existence, triggering its detonation effects and related bookkeeping.

results.name: item_update_free_flight
results.evidence: Iterates up to 10 substeps integrating position (datum+0x1a..0x1c) against gravity/wind-area factors (periodic_function_evaluate, vector3d_rotate_about_axis) and terrain drag constants from the object definition, distinct from the resting-object path in item_update.
results.summary: Performs substep physics integration of an airborne (non-resting) item's position, velocity and spin for one tick.

results.name: resolution_list_add_resolution
results.evidence: Already named from a prior session; body is consistent with a collision-resolution-list builder: heavy vector3d_build_perpendicular/vector3d_project_onto_axis/vector3d_rotate_about_axis math feeding object_recalculate_bounding_radius and object_apply_damage, matching a physics resolution-list entry constructor.
results.summary: Builds/accumulates a collision resolution entry (contact point, normal, penetration response) used by the physics solver for an item's motion.

results.name: item_test_swept_sphere_collision
results.evidence: Solves a quadratic for the closest approach between two moving points expanded by a radius term (fVar6 derived from param_2 and a global scale), returning direction/time/distance outputs; used by the dispatcher FUN_004beec0 when the 'attraction'/expanded-collision flag is set.
results.summary: Computes the closest-approach point and timing between a moving reference point and a swept collision sphere, used for continuous collision detection.

results.name: item_test_direct_collision
results.evidence: Simple linear variant: computes direction/distance between two points via vector3d_normalize_with_length with no quadratic radius expansion; selected by FUN_004beec0 as the non-swept fallback path.
results.summary: Computes the straight-line direction and distance between two points, used as the simple (non-swept) collision test.

results.name: item_test_collision
results.evidence: Chooses between item_test_direct_collision (FUN_004bee20) and item_test_swept_sphere_collision (FUN_004beb30) based on the object definition's flag bit 0x2 at +0x17c and a maximum-radius field at +0x1cc.
results.summary: Dispatches to either the direct or swept-sphere collision test depending on the target object definition's collision-expansion settings.

results.name: item_apply_random_spin
results.evidence: Guarded by datum+0x11c != -1 (an attachment index), adds an incoming vector (in_EDX) to a secondary position field (datum+0x68..0x70) and derives a random angular-velocity kick (datum+0x8c..0x94) scaled by the vector's magnitude, then calls item_compute_spin_rotation (FUN_004c0180).
results.summary: Applies a small random spin/tumble impulse to an attached item part when it is displaced, e.g. jostled ammo or debris.

results.name: item_update_max_permutation_reached
results.evidence: Trivial max update: if the item's current permutation/progress field at datum+0x230 (short) is less than the incoming value, stores the incoming value there.
results.summary: Tracks the highest permutation/progress index an item has reached, used elsewhere to gate animation replay.

results.name: item_notify_state_changed
results.evidence: Same message/broadcast pattern as item_drop and item_notify_ammo_changed (hash_table_get lookups feeding FUN_004ec940 with message id 0x33, then FUN_004e1a80(1,&DAT_00871de0,...)) but without touching position or the role/type word.
results.summary: Broadcasts a generic item state-change notification/message to observers.

results.name: item_attach_to_object
results.evidence: Under the authority gate, fetches the item (object_try_and_get(0x20)) and a target object, sets the world-up basis and the 'dynamic'/no-rest flags (datum+0x8b bit3, datum+4 bit5), calls object_attach_to_object with two marker indices, and derives a pickup-delay timer from the tag's min/max fields (+0x1bc/+0x1c0) converted to a per-tick decrement via *30fps.
results.summary: Attaches an item to a target object at given markers, clears its resting state, and starts a delay timer before it can be interacted with again.

results.name: item_apply_material_collision_response
results.evidence: Looks up a material-response table entry (stride 0xa0 at tag+0x244, indexed by a material id in param_2), evaluates angle/velocity thresholds via vector3d_angle_between_4cd4f0, and, for collision-type 3, calls object_apply_damage with the impact normal and velocity; also creates a 'material change' resolution for type 2 via a nested record.
results.summary: Handles an item's collision against a surface material: selects the bounce/skid response from the surface's material-effect table and optionally applies impact damage.

results.name: item_compute_spin_rotation
results.evidence: Structurally identical to item_compute_ground_alignment_rotation (FUN_004bd500) but operates on the angular-velocity vector (datum+0x8c..0x94, also written by item_accelerate) and stores its sin/cos at datum+0x270/0x274, toggling a bit in datum+0x22c instead of +500.
results.summary: Recomputes the normalized spin axis and its rotation angle (sin/cos) from the item's current angular velocity, for use in procedural tumbling.

results.name: item_update_function_values
results.evidence: Reads up to 4 function-type selectors from the object definition (tag+0x184) and evaluates each against live item state (heat fraction datum[0x94]/tag[0x1c8], speed datum[0x90], or a boolean flag datum[0x8b]&2), storing results into datum+0x49..0x4c for shader/material use.
results.summary: Evaluates the item's tag-defined shader/material function inputs (elapsed-time ratio, speed, boolean state) each tick.

results.name: item_update_despawn_fade
results.evidence: Selects between two tag-defined min/max ranges (+0x1d0/+0x1d4 or +0x1dc/+0x1e0) based on a flag bit, calls FUN_004c03f0 to derive a rate, stores a fade progress value (datum+0x25c) and scale/opacity fallback (datum+0x254=1.0, datum+600=0) when no timer is active.
results.summary: Advances an item's despawn/fade-out timer and scale factor, used for the 'garbage disappears over time' effect.

results.name: item_compute_scale_velocity
results.evidence: Pure kinematics helper: returns (v_max^2 - v_min^2) / (2 * (param_2-param_1)) using tag fields +0x1e4/+0x1e8 read via an implicit item pointer, a standard 'solve for acceleration/rate' formula.
results.summary: Small math helper that derives a scale/fade rate from a start/end value pair and tag-defined velocity bounds.

results.name: item_position_relative_to_ground
results.evidence: Tests a segment from the item's stored anchor (datum+0x17..0x19) to a caller point via FUN_00505880 twice, and when no direct hit is found, projects along the tag's hover-height field (+0x1a0) to find ground-relative endpoints.
results.summary: Computes a corrected position for an item that should hover a fixed height above the ground, testing collision along the way.

results.name: item_detonate
results.evidence: cea-pdb hint 'projectile_detonate' (module items) via string 'gravity'; scatters up to ~7 sibling attached items with randomized reduced velocities, plays a particle effect named by the tag's detonation-effect field via FUN_00450980, and calls object_apply_damage against the parent object.
results.summary: Detonates an item: scatters nearby attached fragments with randomized velocity, plays the detonation effect, and applies damage to the parent object.

results.name: item_build_velocity_update
results.evidence: Sibling of item_build_orientation_update (FUN_004bbc90): copies the item's angular-velocity vector (datum+0x23..0x25) and the flag/sequence pair at +0x27a/+0x27b into a record dispatched via FUN_004ec940 with fixed message id 0x1e.
results.summary: Packages an item's angular-velocity/secondary state into a fixed-format record and sends it as message type 0x1e.

results.name: item_create_garbage_secondary
results.evidence: Near-duplicate of item_create_garbage (FUN_004bbe20): same authority gate, cross-product basis, material lookups and object_new_with_datum_role_control call, but writes the new object's fields at the secondary offset group (+0x27c..0x290).
results.summary: Authoritatively spawns a new garbage-role object using the item's secondary attachment basis, mirroring item_create_garbage.

results.name: item_build_network_update_dynamic_secondary
results.evidence: Near-duplicate of item_build_network_update_dynamic (FUN_004bc0f0) using object_try_and_get(0x20) and the secondary flag/sequence pair at +0x27a/+0x27b instead of +0x245/+0x246.
results.prototype: int __cdecl item_build_network_update_dynamic_secondary(int item_index, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, int update_type)
results.summary: Builds an outgoing per-type network update for an item's secondary attachment/transform state, mirroring item_build_network_update_dynamic.

results.name: item_apply_network_update
results.evidence: Validates a 5-bit modular sequence number against the item's stored one (datum+0x27a/+0x27b) before applying an incoming update record's position/orientation fields (datum+0x1c..0x50 and +0x27c..0x290), calling object_try_and_get(0x20), FUN_004ec600/FUN_004ec590 authority predicates, and vector3d_distance for a snap-vs-interpolate decision.
results.summary: Applies an incoming network update record to an item's position/orientation, rejecting stale packets via a wraparound sequence check.

results.name: item_get_attachment_modifier_sum
results.evidence: Reads two attachment references from the item's attachment table (tag+0x500 -> +0xa0, +0x220) and, for each present one, adds the midpoint of a tag min/max pair (+0x1d4/+0x1d8) from the referenced object's definition.
results.summary: Sums a tag-defined midpoint value contributed by up to two of the item's attachments (e.g. a combined modifier from mounted parts).

results.name: item_new_from_placement
results.evidence: Clamps starting ammo (param_2+0x48) and a second field (param_2+0x4a) against tag-defined maximums (tag+0x4f4 record), then sets item flags (datum+4 bits 0x20/0x20000, datum+0x7d bit 0x20) from a byte flag field in the placement record (param_2+0x4c).
results.prototype: unsigned int __cdecl item_new_from_placement(unsigned int item_index, int placement_data)
results.summary: Initializes a newly-placed item's starting ammunition/trigger counts and dynamic-state flags from a scenario placement record.

results.name: item_update_triggers
results.evidence: Early-outs on the global pause flag (DAT_0071c419), decays heat/reload timers (datum+0x8f/0x92), then iterates the item's trigger array (tag+0x4fc count) dispatching on a per-trigger state byte (0..8) to helper functions (FUN_004c3190..FUN_004c3eb0) and swapping the 'primary-blur' permutation via object_set_permutation_by_name.
results.summary: Per-tick update of an item's trigger/ammunition state machine: heat and reload decay, per-trigger state dispatch, and barrel/permutation swapping effects.

results.name: item_get_type_name
results.evidence: Returns a pointer to the tag definition's string field at +0x30c for a valid item, or a shared empty-string constant (DAT_0065512c) otherwise.
results.summary: Returns a name/label string associated with the item's object type, or an empty string if the item is invalid.

results.name: item_notify_ammo_changed
results.evidence: Called from item_transfer_ammunition (FUN_004c2610) after a magazine transfer; resolves a hash_table_get lookup and sends message id 0x2c via FUN_004ec940 followed by FUN_004e1a80(1,&DAT_00871de0,...), the same broadcast pattern used by item_drop.
results.summary: Broadcasts a notification that an item's ammunition/rounds count has changed.

results.name: item_add_ammunition
results.evidence: Under the authority gate, object_try_and_get(4) fetches a target, then adds a signed count (local_2) to a per-trigger loaded-rounds field at (target+0x2b6 + trigger*0xc), the same field family used by item_update_triggers for magazine counts.
results.summary: Adds (or removes) a number of rounds from one of an item's trigger magazines.

results.name: item_transfer_ammunition
results.evidence: Walks both items' trigger tables (tag+0x4f0 count), computing how many rounds can move from the source trigger's magazine (+0x2b0 record) into the destination's per-trigger counter (+0x2b6), invoking item_notify_ammo_changed, item_definition_reset_change_color_function (FUN_004bbbd0) and sound/effect helpers on transfer.
results.prototype: unsigned int __cdecl item_transfer_ammunition(unsigned int target_item_index, unsigned int source_item_index, short unused_arg, short *out_transferred)
results.summary: Transfers loaded ammunition rounds from one item's trigger magazine into another's, up to available capacity, and reports the amount moved.

results.name: item_start_permutation_animation
results.evidence: Resets deployment helpers (FUN_004c4b50, FUN_004c5670(9,1)), allocates/starts a sound channel for sound id 0xc via FUN_00494010/FUN_004940f0, and stores a duration from item_get_permutation_duration-family FUN_004c2f80 into the reload/cooldown timer field datum+0x23a.
results.summary: Starts an item's action animation/sound (e.g. ready/deploy) and its associated cooldown timer.

results.name: item_stop_permutation_animation
results.evidence: Mirrors item_start_permutation_animation: resets the current permutation index (datum+0x230=0), cancels a pending effect handle at datum+0x2cc via FUN_00450be0, and stops sound id 0xb on the item's sound channel.
results.summary: Stops an item's current action animation/sound and cancels any associated looping effect.

results.name: item_set_permutation
results.evidence: Directly stores the given index into the item's active-permutation field (datum+0x230, the same field referenced across item_update_triggers, item_get_next_permutation_index, etc.) and stores a duration from FUN_004ccac0 into datum+0x234.
results.summary: Sets the item's active model permutation index and its associated duration.

results.name: item_get_ammunition_state
results.evidence: Fills a caller-provided buffer with the item's reserve/loaded ammo counts (datum+0x8f/0x90), a single-trigger flag (datum+0x8b bit0), the trigger count (tag+0x4f0), and per-trigger loaded/empty flags and round counts (datum+0xae/+0x2b6 family) -- matches the field layout used throughout item_update_triggers.
results.summary: Builds a summary of an item's ammunition and per-trigger state, likely consumed by HUD rendering.

results.name: item_is_first_trigger_charged
results.evidence: Returns true only if the item has at least one trigger (tag+0x4f0 > 0) and its first trigger's state field (datum+0xac) equals 1, matching the 'charged/locked' state seen dispatched in item_update_triggers.
results.summary: Reports whether an item's primary trigger is currently in the charged/locked state.

results.name: item_set_alignment_axis_x
results.evidence: Trivial single-field setter storing param_1 into datum+0x248, the same field written by item_create_garbage as one component of a new object's ground-alignment/normal vector.
results.summary: Sets one float component of an item's stored alignment/normal vector.

results.name: item_test_attachment_collision
results.evidence: Validates an attachment index against the tag's attachment count (+0x4fc), resolves the attachment's tag data, then forwards to item_test_collision (FUN_004beec0) with the item's own position parameters.
results.summary: Runs the item's collision test against one of its tag-defined attachments, if the index is valid.

results.name: item_get_attachment_time_fraction
results.evidence: For a valid attachment index, divides param_1 by the attachment's tag-defined duration field (+0x1e4), returning a normalized time fraction.
results.summary: Computes a normalized time fraction for one of the item's attachments given an elapsed value and its tag-defined duration.

results.name: item_is_depleted
results.evidence: Returns true when the item's charge/heat fraction (datum+0x90) is below 1.0 and either it has no triggers, the first trigger's magazine is empty, or its rounds-loaded/left counters (datum+0xae, +0x2b6) are both zero.
results.summary: Reports whether an item is out of charge/ammunition and cannot currently be used.

results.name: item_get_next_permutation_index
results.evidence: Advances the supplied permutation index by one, clamped to the tag's permutation count (+0x3da), but only when the item has no active trigger sequence (tag+0x4f0 <=0 or trigger state != 1).
results.summary: Returns the next valid model permutation index for an item, unless a trigger animation is currently locking it.

results.name: item_get_permutation_duration
results.evidence: Normalizes a permutation index against the tag's permutation count (+0x3da) and evaluates FUN_006283c0 with tag-defined scale/rate fields (+0x3dc/+0x3e0), matching a per-permutation duration lookup used by item_start_permutation_animation.
results.summary: Computes the intended playback duration for a given item permutation index.

results.name: item_clamp_permutation_duration
results.evidence: Wraps item_get_permutation_duration (FUN_004c2d70), falling back to the raw input duration when the ratio is degenerate (==1.0) or outside a plausible small-angle range.
results.summary: Clamps a caller-supplied duration against the item's tag-defined permutation duration, falling back when the computed ratio looks invalid.

results.name: item_definition_test_flag3
results.evidence: Returns bit 3 of the object definition's flags field at tag+0x308; exact semantic meaning of this bit is not otherwise evidenced in this batch.
results.summary: Tests a single unidentified flag bit (bit 3 of the +0x308 flags field) in the item's object type definition.

results.name: item_is_trigger_charging
results.evidence: Returns true (default) for an invalid item, otherwise true if the per-trigger state byte at datum+0x261 equals 2 or 3 (states dispatched in item_update_triggers) or bit 9 of the tag's +0x308 flags field is set.
results.summary: Reports whether an item's trigger is currently in a charging-related state, or the item type is otherwise flagged as such.

results.name: item_is_attachment_active
results.evidence: Returns true (default) for an invalid item, otherwise true if a byte field (datum+0x8e) falls in range 5..10 or bit 6 of the tag's +0x308 flags field is set.
results.summary: Reports whether one of the item's attachments is currently in an active state, or the item type is otherwise flagged as such.

results.name: item_get_attachment_state_index
results.evidence: Follows the item's attachment-set reference (tag+0x478) into a per-attachment lookup table (using tag+0x48/+0x4c), then reads either offset +0x22 or +0x34 of the located record depending on param_1, with a special-case dual-trigger lookup when the tag's +0x4e2 field equals 1.
results.summary: Looks up a state/permutation index associated with one of the item's zoom/scope-style attachments for a given category and mode.

results.name: item_has_active_state
results.evidence: Returns false only when all of the item's per-trigger state bytes (datum+0x261, +0x289, stride 0x28 matching item_update_triggers' trigger record size), a permutation-related short (+0x2b0), a counter (+700), and a byte (+0x238) are zero; used to gate item_start_permutation_animation/item_stop_permutation_animation.
results.summary: Reports whether an item currently has any active trigger, animation, or timer state.

results.name: item_is_idle
results.evidence: Simplified counterpart of item_has_active_state: returns true only when both trigger state bytes (+0x261, +0x289) and a byte flag (+0x238) are all zero.
results.summary: Reports whether an item's triggers are fully idle (no in-progress state).
